run_hab3_benchmark: run the habitat lab benchmark measuring FPS across multiple processes and GPUs
create_env_habitat: create a habitat environment with GPU assignment from config and command line opts
sample_action_space_wrapper: sample random actions from a wrapped action space including oracle nav and humanoid pick
